No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this lecture you understand stratigraphy, radiocarbon and typology.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. The lecture can be given online or at your venue, for a single class, a department or a whole organisation.

What it covers

  • Relative dating
  • Absolute dating
  • Argument

How the time is spent

  1. Relative dating 20 min

    Typology, stratigraphy and seriation.

    You: sequence exercise

  2. Absolute dating 45 min

    Radiocarbon basics, calibration and sample context.

    You: confidence worksheet

  3. Argument 25 min

    Combine dates and site history.

    You: write cautious claim

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
